prompt: Create ONE landscape visual specimen of four mysterious ORIGINAL arcane written characters for GRIMOIRE, left to right EMBER WIND WARD GATHER. Revision of previous too-simple fantasy calligraphy: radically more occult manuscript / runic inscription feeling, NOT just adding glow to ordinary letters. Four evenly spaced individual characters, no card frames or labels, flat deep midnight navy backdrop. Thin-to-medium crisp antique pale gold strokes with restrained icy cyan inner luminescence. Each glyph a compact intentional complex written sign made from 6-9 disciplined strokes: strong runic main stem, angular branching ligatures, one tiny open-ring terminal and a few short offset diacritical ticks integrated into its structure. Shared writing grammar but strongly distinct silhouettes. EMBER narrow upward branching asymmetrical fork with central lozenge and interrupted lower stem; WIND wide oblique hooked branches sweeping laterally with staggered ticks; WARD firm upright paired boundary stems bridged by stepped crossbars and one angular inner enclosure; GATHER inward reaching mirrored hooks around a central lozenge with a descending collector stroke. Shapes feel inscribed by a scholar to encode a spell, elegant and genuinely enigmatic, neither simple logo nor recognisable Latin letters. Take general structural inspiration from historic angular runic lettering and early-modern magical manuscript characters, but invent forms, do not copy actual alphabets, religious seals, inscriptions or any franchise. No giant surrounding magic circles, no pentagrams, no stars, no literal flame/wind/shield/magnet icons, no random background alphabet, no heavy bloom, no illustration, no people, no numbers, no explanatory words. Each character must remain a readable dark/light silhouette; do not turn them into overdecorated mandalas. One same-scale row, generous margins.
